'''Luthus Ferlani''' was the criminal leader of the [[Ferlani family]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and on into the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He spent most of his career representing the Ferlani family on business trips throughout the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] and within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Outwardly, Luthus was a respectable and kindly gentleman. However, he was easily angered and could be terrifying in his outbursts. His subordinates were quick to see to his bidding, in fear of being punished.

Luthus and his family owned the famous [[Togatto Speedway/Legends|Togatto Speedway]] on Esseles.
